notes: "Before polishing any single slide, I read the deck as a story. The Outline view lists every slide with its title, its Story summary and its Slide ID, grouped by Section, so I can see whether the argument holds. Browse shows the same slides as thumbnails, for density and rhythm. Sections divide the talk into parts; each starts at a stable first slide and runs to the next."

designIntent.purpose: Show the Outline view for reading the argument; relate Browse and Sections.
designIntent.requestedChange: Story-driven rework: organise the founder's reasons for building HUANDENG and show the features that answer them.
designIntent.source: Owner's spoken story, 11 Nov 2026 (sources/story/USER-STORY.zh-CN.md); facts in sources/story/FACTS.md
